message:
My array turns Dr. Amara Okafor's light-touch pressure into electricity with squeezable parallel-plate capacitors, where Taxel means tactile pixel and CDC means Capacitance-to-Digital Converter. Plain words: a 1 millinewton touch squeezes the soft dielectric and raises capacitance by a few femtofarads that a standard converter chip can resolve. The Single-Step Fabrication of Porous Elastomer for High Sensitivity Pressure Sensor | IITBombay (E24) shows the parallel-plate construction with dielectric between plates, the CDC enables touch-control sensitivity in portable electronic devices (E20) states femtofarad resolution on 13 inputs, and the Capacitance Sensing in Human Body Contact Applications (E21) states 16-bit femtofarad measurement. The numbers that decide it are 0.269 picofarads base in the base capacitance calculation (E26) and 3.57 femtofarads change at 5.78 kilopascals from the Hertz contact radius for 1mN on soft silicone (E14) in the delta capacitance calculation (E28), about the weight of a 0.102 gram grain of sand and therefore a real gentle-touch signal above femtofarad noise.

Pitch and curvature preserve that spot without stiffening the skin for Dr. Elena Vasquez and Dr. Marcus Reid. Plain words: small closely spaced electrodes share the tiny pressure spot for centroid location and ride on flat facets around the fingertip curve with a thin stack. The VecTile: A Low-Cost Flexible Tactile Array for 3-DoF Force Sensing (E16) shows a flexible tactile array, the Physical AI | Robotiq (E17) shows pressure read across a 28-taxel capacitive array for contact shape and intensity, and the Tactile acuity - Perception Study Guide 2024 | Fiveable (E23) gives 1 to 2 millimetres fingertip two-point threshold. The numbers that decide it are 2.00 millimetre pitch and 1.50 millimetre electrodes sharing the 0.470 millimetre diameter spot from the Hertz contact radius for 1mN on soft silicone (E14), with 200 micrometre dielectric in the curved array sketch (E29).

Not ready, because my signal path needs Dr. Elena Vasquez slip sampling and Dr. Marcus Reid converter readout and message choices to prove the 3.57 femtofarad change survives crosstalk to the hand.
